rationale: The stock is trading at 87.8% of today's range after a massive gap-down of nearly 18%, with no news catalyst available to explain the move or anchor a thesis. While the 5-minute price action shows a strong recovery off the $28.20 low and is above the 5-min VWAP ($29.73) and 9-EMA ($30.37), the current price is within 1.24% of today's high — entering long here risks buying near resistance with the gap-fill thesis largely already played out, and a short near a recovering high without a clear catalyst for further downside is equally unattractive. With an already negative day P&L and one open position, the risk/reward does not justify a new entry.
